title: MSFS 2024 New bush trips: Poland & Baltics Part 3, 4 + bundle
description:
Explore World Update 23 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 with Koschi’s new Poland and the Baltics Bush Trips—Part 3, Part 4, and the 4-part Bundle.

Koschi has completed the Poland and the Baltics Bush Trip series in the MSFS 2024 Marketplace, bringing two new VFR expeditions and a discounted complete bundle for low-and-slow flyers. In this weekly Marketplace activities breakdown, we look at Part 3—taking you across Lithuania and Vilnius—and Part 4, the series finale that picks up right where Part 3 ends and guides you along coastal waterways and river corridors to Riga and Tallinn. Both bush trips are built around the handcrafted landmarks and updated scenery from World Update 23 (which simply needs to be enabled in MSFS 2024), and feature multilingual mission support, unlocked flight options, and multiplayer compatibility so you can fly the routes with friends.
